duration: About 6–7 minutes at 115–125 English words/minute including slide changes

script.en:
You have seen what Civilization Voyage feels like to play. I will now explain how we built it, and how it could become a sustainable cultural product.
Our project documents assign design to Claude, API work to Codex, and frontend and 3D work to Grok. We connected those pieces locally, tested the interactions, and updated the desktop app. Lovable offers a useful comparison for this kind of natural-language development. Our repository, however, does not establish a Lovable origin.
script.zh: 前面大家已经看到了文明航程的游玩体验。接下来我介绍它怎样被做出来，以及如何成为可以持续经营的文化产品。项目文档记录了Claude负责设计、Codex负责接口、Grok负责前端与3D的分工。我们在本机连接这些部分，测试互动，再更新桌面App。Lovable可以帮助理解自然语言开发这类工作方式，但不能说本项目由Lovable导出。

script.en:
AI helped us build faster. We still had to decide which stories belonged together, check their historical order, and make the choices understandable.
For us, responsible design means making the system’s limits visible and leaving room for human judgment. That principle also belongs inside our game: when technology becomes more capable, who remains responsible?
script.zh: AI让制作更快，但故事怎样组合、年代是否正确、选择能否看懂，仍需要人判断。对我们而言，负责任的设计应当说明系统的局限，让人保留判断的空间。这也呼应游戏的问题——技术更强大之后，谁继续承担责任？

script.en: That brings us to the business. We see three possible audiences: players who want a good cultural adventure, educators who need usable teaching material, and museums seeking new ways to share local stories. They can share a content foundation, but each needs a different offer.
script.zh: 由此进入商业部分。三类潜在使用场景分别是：玩家寻找有吸引力的文化冒险，教师需要可以组织使用的教学材料，博物馆希望以新的方式讲述地方故事。它们共享内容基础，但购买的东西并不相同。

script.en: These figures are planning assumptions, not sales we have achieved. Our base case combines two thousand paying players, ten institutions and two museum projects, producing three hundred and seventy-six thousand yuan in revenue. The other scenarios show how much that result depends on demand. Costs come next.
script.zh: 这里的数字都是规划假设，不是已经取得的销售。基准情景是2000名付费玩家、10家机构、2个文博项目，对应37.6万元收入。谨慎和扩展情景说明结果会怎样随需求变化。后面还要扣成本。

script.en:
We chose Discovery Tour and Minecraft Education as competitive benchmarks. Discovery Tour offers historical exploration, while Minecraft Education supports classroom learning. Their pricing also gives us a reference for designing our own offers.
Our opportunity is to connect cultural exploration with learning through choices. Players encounter Chinese and world histories, make decisions, and reflect on their consequences. This gives us a shared foundation for individual play, classroom discussion and museum storytelling.
So, how do we turn this positioning into something customers can buy? Here are our three proposed offers.
script.zh: 我们选择Discovery Tour和Minecraft Education作为对标竞品。前者提供历史探索，后者支持课堂学习，其定价也为我们设计商品提供参考。我们的机会是把文化探索与通过选择进行学习结合起来。玩家进入中华文明与世界历史，作出决定，再反思后果。这为个人游玩、课堂讨论和文博叙事提供共同内容基础。那么，怎样把这个定位变成客户可以购买的产品？下一页就是三种拟议方案。

script.en: The three images show three different offers. On the left, players buy the full game for a proposed sixty-eight yuan. In the middle, the industrial story becomes a discussion guide, within an education service priced at twelve thousand yuan per year. On the right, the communication story becomes an exhibit concept, within a sixty-thousand-yuan museum project. The last two are proposed services. Their prices include work beyond the game itself.
script.zh: 三张图对应三种商品。左边是完整游戏，拟价68元；中间是工业时代的讨论指南，属于每年1.2万元的拟议教育服务；右边是通信史展陈概念，属于6万元的拟议文博项目。后两项仍是规划中的服务，价格包含游戏本身之外的交付工作。

script.en: The funnel makes our growth assumptions visible: one hundred thousand qualified visits, ten thousand trials, and two thousand purchases. Every step needs testing. If people leave before enjoying the game, more advertising simply brings more people to the same problem.
script.zh: 漏斗把增长假设拆开：10万次合格访问、1万次体验、2000次购买。每一步都需要验证。如果用户还没感受到乐趣就离开，增加广告只会让更多人遇见同一个问题。

script.en: Our longer-term advantage would come from the work behind each story: reviewed sources, clear image rights, strong characters, and a production process we can reuse. Over time, a trusted catalogue and lasting partnerships could make each new release easier to create and distribute.
script.zh: 长期优势来自每个故事背后的工作：审读过的来源、清楚的图片权利、有感染力的人物，以及可以复用的制作流程。持续积累的内容和合作关系，可能让下一部作品更容易制作、也更容易被找到。

script.en:
The base case is still loss-making. After delivery and acquisition costs, it leaves one hundred and sixty thousand eight hundred yuan. Against fixed investment of two hundred and forty thousand yuan, the gap is seventy-nine thousand two hundred.
That gap matters. We need stronger demand, lower delivery costs, or a smaller initial commitment before expansion makes sense.
script.zh: 基准情景依然亏损。收入扣除交付与获客后剩下16.08万元；面对24万元固定投入，缺口为7.92万元。这个缺口意味着，在扩大投入前，我们需要更强的需求、更低的交付成本，或者缩小初期承诺。

script.en: So our sequence is clear: first make the existing game worth finishing and returning to; then test paid story packs and educational use; then expand through cultural partnerships. Each stage should earn the next through evidence of repeat use and payment.
script.zh: 因此先把现有游戏做到值得玩完、值得再来；再测试付费故事包和教育使用；之后通过文化伙伴扩展内容和传播。进入下一阶段，要有重复使用和真实支付作为依据。

script.en: Our illustrative cash envelope is three hundred and sixty thousand yuan. It includes product development, content review, operations, delivery float and a reserve. We would release one hundred and twenty thousand first, then stage the rest against results. The delivery float covers payment timing; it is not another expense to deduct twice.
script.zh: 示例资金规划为36万元，包括开发、内容审读、运营、交付周转和储备。先释放12万元，再根据验证结果分阶段使用其余资金。周转金用于等待回款，不能在费用中再重复扣一次。

script.en: The hardest risks are practical: meaningful stories that are not enjoyable, interested institutions without budgets, and custom projects that exhaust the team. We will need player testing, real purchasing conversations, and firm limits on bespoke work.
script.zh: 最困难的风险很具体：内容有意义却不好玩；机构感兴趣却没有预算；定制订单不断消耗团队。应对方式是实际试玩、与采购人核实预算，以及明确限制定制范围。

script.en:
Civilization Voyage begins with Chinese civilization and opens a conversation with world cultures. Across its four eras, the question remains: as our tools become more powerful, how do we choose to live together?
We want to build stories people enjoy returning to, and a business that lets us keep telling them.
Thank you.
script.zh: 文明航程从中华文明出发，与世界文化展开对话。穿过四个时代，同一个问题始终存在：当我们的工具越来越强大，我们选择怎样共同生活？我们希望创作出人们愿意再次走进的故事，也建立能够支持持续创作的事业。谢谢。

qa.question: Are these actual revenues? / 这些收入已经实现了吗？
qa.en: No. The game is playable, but the commercial figures are scenarios. We still need to test willingness to pay, conversion and delivery cost.
qa.zh: 没有。游戏可以运行，但商业数字是情景假设。付费意愿、转化率、交付成本仍待验证。

qa.question: Why these prices? / 为什么这样定价？
qa.en: They are starting points for tests, tied to different delivery scopes. External products help us understand payment models; customer research and measured costs must determine our own prices.
qa.zh: 它们是不同交付范围下的测试起点。竞品帮助理解付费形式，最终定价需要用户研究和实际成本支持。

qa.question: Why pursue it if the base case loses money? / 基准亏损为什么还要做？
qa.en: The model identifies the conditions we must improve before expanding. We would limit the initial commitment and use real purchases and delivery hours to decide whether to continue.
qa.zh: 模型说明扩大投入前必须改善什么。先限制初期支出，再根据真实购买和交付工时决定是否继续。

qa.question: What would break even? / 怎样达到收支平衡？
qa.en: Under the same assumptions, with ten education contracts and two museum projects, about 4,445 paying players would cover the fixed cost. That still requires checking capacity and acquisition costs.
qa.zh: 维持10家机构、2个文博项目和单位成本不变时，约4445名付费玩家可覆盖固定投入；仍要检验团队产能及获客成本是否上升。

qa.question: Is the game powered by live AI? / 游戏是实时AI生成的吗？
qa.en: The current stories and rules are authored. AI tools supported development. Source-grounded retrieval is a possible next step, not a completed feature.
qa.zh: 当前剧情和规则经过编写，AI工具用于辅助开发。带来源的检索是后续方向，不是已完成功能。

qa.question: Was it built in Lovable? / 是用Lovable搭建的吗？
qa.en: We use Lovable as a comparison for the workflow. Our repository documents local development and model handoffs; it does not establish that the project was exported from Lovable.
qa.zh: Lovable是工作流参照。仓库记录的是本机开发和模型分工，没有证据说明项目从Lovable导出。

qa.question: Why can open-source software be a business? / 开源怎么商业化？
qa.en: Customers would pay for a reliable experience, reviewed content, updates and clearly defined services. We cannot claim exclusive ownership of MIT-licensed code.
qa.zh: 付费价值在稳定体验、经过审读的内容、更新与清楚的服务范围。不能把MIT开源代码说成排他资产。

qa.question: Why is the budget larger than fixed cost? / 36万元与24万元是什么关系？
qa.en: The 240,000 covers planned fixed work. Another 90,000 is delivery float and 30,000 is contingency. They are cash buffers, not extra expenses already incurred.
qa.zh: 24万元是固定工作投入，另有9万元交付周转、3万元风险储备；后两项是现金缓冲，不是已发生费用。
